brand_constants.canonical_trident_structure: REFERENCE IMAGE REQUIRED — Upload the provided Poseidon trident logo image. The trident has three swept, curved prongs that arc outward with fluid, organic lines (NOT straight or rigidly geometric). The prongs taper to sharp points at the top. The three prongs converge at a single point at the bottom center, forming a small inverted-V or diamond-shaped junction — there is NO handle, NO shaft, NO stem below the convergence point. The silhouette ends at the convergence. The material is frosted translucent glass with a cyan-to-blue gradient (#00F0FF at the prong tips transitioning to #3B82F6 at the base), with a subtle violet-purple (#8B5CF6) tint on the rightmost prong. A bright glowing white emission point radiates from the center where the prongs converge. Sharp 1-pixel glowing specular highlights trace every beveled edge. The glass refracts and reflects subtle cyan ambient light from within. CRITICAL: The logo has NO handle, NO shaft, NO vertical stem below the prongs. It is NOT a classical mythological trident. Use the provided reference image as the only source of truth.
